Our Aaron Chalmers face mask is a quick way to get everyone laughing, whether it's for a series finale watch party or a telly-night quiz. Pair it with a costume, or keep it simple and let the TV star face do the talking.

Aaron Chalmers Celebrity Face Mask

We print this TV star mask in full colour on thick 350gsm silk card, cut it to the shape of the face and pre-cut the eye holes. Elastic and sticky tabs are included. Need a face we don't stock, such as the groom or a friend? Send us a photo and we'll make a custom mask.

Why you'll love it

  • Thick 350gsm silk card holds its shape all night
  • Semi-waterproof finish, so it copes with spilt drinks and outdoor parties
  • Pre-cut eye holes, with elastic and sticky tabs included
  • Full-colour digital print for a sharp, recognisable face
  • Posted flat in a board-backed envelope to keep it crease-free

Size & details

  • Material: 350gsm silk card, full-colour digital print
  • Finish: semi-waterproof
  • Fit: one size for adults; elastic and sticky tabs included
  • Pre-cut eye holes; cut to the shape of the face
  • Packaging: board-backed envelope

Delivery

Printed in our UK workshop and posted to you. Dispatch and postage options are shown at checkout.
